messages:
alex: heads up — p99 jump on canary after burst-slicer rollout. p95 ~420ms, p99 peaked ~1.6s. Seen on gen+tool paths.

maya: saw it in console. correlates with bursts that have >=2 tool calls and one long prompt (>2k tokens). p95 stable, tail moves.

sam: I pulled a flamegraph from stage. main hotspots: kernel_hop (10-30ms per hop) + KV::lookup miss spike when tool-call happens mid-gen.

sam: profile snippet:
```text
flamegraph: gen_loop -> kernel_hop -> compile_kernel
cpu: 72% kernel_hop
kv_lookup: 18% (misses spike)
batcher_wait: 12% (head-of-line)
```

devon: thinking: burst-slicer batches by earliest ready; if a tool-call forces seq_len reprioritization we switch kernel mid-stream. compile_kernel cost + waiting for microbatch boundary = tail.

alex: repro steps I used:
```bash
# replay stage trace
curl -X POST https://stage.api/redwood/generate -d @repro.json -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'
# repro payload mixes long system prompt + tool calls
```

maya: also noticed KV keys sometimes mis-tagged when tool returns structured output -> cache miss for continuation tokens. that + waiting for batch fill makes p99 worse.

devon: quick mitigations:
- pin kernel per-request when seq change exceeds threshold
- early-KV-warmup on predicted tool-call
- small-batch fastpath for tool-call heavy requests

Which should we try first?

sam: vote: small-batch fastpath + KV tag fix. pinning kernel helps but may hurt throughput baseline.

alex: agree. small-batch fastpath prototype: skip continuous-batcher for requests with tool-call probability > 0.5 or long prompts >1.5k tokens.

devon: I'll sketch change. also add p99 alert scoped to kernel_hop and kv_miss_rate.

deploy-bot: rolled out canary patch 0.59 -> 0.59.1 to stage at 2026-03-18T16:40:00Z (burst-slicer fastpath enabled)

maya: after patch: p99 for stage dropped from 1.6s -> 480ms in 10m window. p95 unchanged. :thumbsup:

alex: follow-ups:
- add integration test with tool-call loop to guard regression
- add tracing tag to kernel transitions
- measure throughput impact of small-batch fastpath

assign: devon (fastpath), sam (kv-tag), maya (alerts)

devon: starting PR, will post draft perf numbers

sam: noted, will add replay harness for longer prompts

alex: thanks team. keep updates here.
